overview.text: Jimmy Gomez has represented California’s 34th District in the U.S. House since 2017. He previously served in the California State Assembly and worked as a union organizer for AFSCME and the United Nurses Associations of California. In the House he sits on the Ways and Means Committee, is a Deputy Whip for the Progressive Caucus, and founded the Congressional Renters Caucus.
